visualCharacteristics.purpose: News/event cards with photo, date tag, H3 title, excerpt and Read More button; 3 across on desktop
visualCharacteristics.description: New variant (no existing cards variants in project): Photo-top cards with date tag, H3, excerpt and Read More button; 3 across Cream (#f9f2e6) band; centered intro, three news cards, centered "View all news" button.

cells: text: optional date/eyebrow, heading, description, CTA link

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 date paragraph (before the heading), H3 title, excerpt, trailing Read More link paragraph

usage: Latest news and events listings; the intro and "View all news" button are default content.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for dated article/event teasers. For icon-led feature cards use cards-feature.
